stories.title: Golf, but quieter: Is this the end of LIV Golf?
stories.summary: The 2026 LIV Golf season wrapped up in Indianapolis. While there are plans being worked on for new financing, the future of the upstart league remains uncertain.

stories.title: Watson, now Browns' QB1, regrets ripping fans
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson will open the season as the Browns' starting quarterback, coach Todd Monken announced Monday.

stories.title: Niners owner York arrested in prostitution case
stories.summary: 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to a pair of misdemeanor charges after being arrested in Ohio on suspicion of engaging in prostitution.

stories.title: Sources: Kanter not WNBA-eligible; arena ban TBD
stories.summary: The WNBA has not announced any plans to ban Enes Kanter Freedom from attending future games but, according to multiple sources, the ex-NBA player will not be eligible to play in the league.

stories.title: Ole Miss had FBI sweep for Kiffin-planted bugs
stories.summary: The executive director of Ole Miss' NIL collective said the FBI searched the Rebels' football office for recording devices after Lane Kiffin left for rival LSU.
